div.head: VII Atr 2.2a
div.ab: Et super hoc cantet omnis presbiter XXX missas et omnis diaconus et clericus XXX psalmos.
Et super hoc cantet omnis presbiter XXX missas et omnis diaconus et clericus XXX psalmos.
Et super hoc cantet omnis presbyter XXX missas et omnis diaconus et clericus XXX psalmos.
Und ausserdem singe jeder Priester dreissig Messen und jeder Diakon und Kleriker dreissig Psalmen.
And in addition let every priest sing thirty masses and every deacon and clerk thirty psalms.
And in addition every priest shall sing 30 masses, and every deacon and cleric 30 psalms.
And moreover, every priest is to sing thirty Masses, and every deacon and cleric thirty psalms.
div.note: AU: corrected against Rabin p. 180, October 2026 (was “xxx; xxx”, now “XXX; XXX”)

note.seg: fehlt Agsächs. Bussedikt; s. o. Einl. 3; u. 3, 2; Gl Psalm 3. a. Dreissig sealma singt Worcester für seinen Wohltäter; Urk. a. 873—99 Bi 579. Mönch und niederer Klerus singt Psalmen, wo Priester Messe feiert; s. Gl Fürbitte 3a ff.

missing in the Anglo-Saxon penitential edict; see above Introduction 3; below 3, 2; Gl Psalm 3. a. Worcester sings thirty sealma for its benefactor; charter a. 873—99 Bi 579. Monks and lower clergy sing psalms where priests celebrate mass; see Gl Fürbitte 3a ff.
This clause does not appear in the A.S. text.
